gap: No result ChatGPT got states the focus mismatch: a feeder puts the bird a few inches from the lens, but Blink tunes its motion detection for 7–19 ft (PIR on the Outdoor 4), a named reviewer found a security cam in the Wasserstein case blurry at that range but sharp at a foot or two, and the 4–8 inch diopter Wyze sells as its fix appears only on one Wyze page that ChatGPT left uncited.
standout_why: I compared the four pages ChatGPT cited: Wyze 'Is 24/7 Local Recording going away?' (updated May 14, 2026), Wyze 'Can Wyze Cam v3 record events continuously?', Blink 'Local Storage with Sync Module' (681665) and Blink 'Storage Options'. All four cover only storage and subscriptions. None says anything about focus distance or the range motion detection is tuned for. ChatGPT also got Wyze's 'How does Wyze Bird Feeder take clear up-close bird pictures?' page, which gives the 4–8 inch diopter, but did not cite it. Its answer only said 'Many security cameras aren't designed for extreme close-ups' and told the shopper to test. Nothing in its results covers Blink's 7–19 ft detection range or the named reviews that found the case blurry. So the storage half of the answer (microSD for Wyze, Sync Module 2 for Blink) is already covered and adds nothing.
decides: This backs ChatGPT's 'pick Wyze' advice, but for a reason it never gave. Wyze makes a close-up lens for its own cams (the lens bracket that comes with the Wyze Bird Feeder, a 4–8 in diopter) and lists the v3, v3 Pro, v4, Outdoor v1/v2 and Battery Cam Pro as compatible. Blink publishes no close-up fix and says its detection works best at 7–19 ft. Our Wasserstein case row needs a warning: the case puts the camera close but does not fix focus. Jim Vorel (Paste) got blurry video of birds 'only a few inches away' and suggests mounting the camera about a foot from the feeder. Adam Juniper (Digital Camera World) lists 'Security cameras can't focus closely enough' as a con. The storage rules still apply. Blink's XT/XT2 and Indoor (1st Gen) cannot use local storage at all, and neither can a Sync Module Core, so an older Blink or one on a Core module cannot save clips without a subscription.

findings.label: Motion detection method and best range
findings.value: PIR (heat); best at about 7–19 ft (2–6 m), responds at up to 30 ft
findings.note: PIR cameras: Outdoor 4, Wired Floodlight, Outdoor/Indoor (3rd Gen), Indoor (1st Gen), XT2, XT. Mini and Mini 2 use pixel-difference analysis instead. Blink: 'Objects that are the same apparent temperature as the background may not be detected' and PIR 'can be sensitive to … blowing leaves'. Blink also says 'A bird flying close to the camera can be perceived as bigger'. Blink publishes no close-up lens or minimum focus distance.

findings.label: Blink cameras and modules without local storage
findings.value: XT, XT2, Indoor (1st Gen) and Sync Module Core: no local storage or Clip Backup
findings.source_title: Local Storage with Sync Module — Blink Support
findings.note: Local storage works on Mini, Mini 2, Outdoor 4, Wired Floodlight, Video Doorbell and Indoor/Outdoor (3rd Gen). It needs a Sync Module 2 with a USB-A drive or a Sync Module XR with microSD (1–256 GB, exFAT recommended), and all cameras must be on the same Wi-Fi network as the module. This is a page ChatGPT cited, so it is not new to the shopper.
